name: Aetna
ivr_hints: Press 2 for Provider Services, then press 1 for Prior Authorization, then say or enter Provider NPI followed by Patient Member ID.

name: UnitedHealthcare
ivr_hints: Say 'Provider', then say 'Prior Authorization', then state medical specialty when prompted.

name: Blue Cross Blue Shield
ivr_hints: Enter 10-digit NPI, then press 3 for Authorizations and Pre-certifications, followed by the 3-letter prefix of Member ID.

name: Cigna
ivr_hints: Say 'Healthcare Professional', then say 'Prior Authorization', then enter Tax ID and Member ID.

name: Humana
ivr_hints: Press 1 for Providers, then press 4 for Pre-Authorization / Pre-Certification, then enter Member ID.

name: Medicare (CMS)
ivr_hints: Say 'Provider Services', then 'Prior Authorization', then follow MAC contractor prompts.

name: Medicaid (State Plan)
ivr_hints: Follow state-specific prompts for medical provider authorizations, then enter Billing NPI.

name: Kaiser Permanente
ivr_hints: Press 3 for External Referral and Prior Authorization department.

name: Molina Healthcare
ivr_hints: Press 2 for Prior Authorization, enter 10-digit NPI followed by pound (#).
